author: kuwa6805
title: PyTorch model-hub tests fail to clone mvafin/ALIKED due to SSL certificate verification error
signature: unable to access server certificate verification failed cafile none crlfile none|Network

failed_jobs.name: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: setup error: git clone/checkout of https://github.com/mvafin/ALIKED.git fails with 'server certificate verification failed: CAfile: none CRLfile: none'

key_errors: subprocess.CalledProcessError: Command ['git', 'checkout', '6008af43942925eec7e32006814ef41fbd0858d8'] returned non-zero exit status 128.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/mvafin/ALIKED.git/': server certificate verification failed. CAfile: none CRLfile: none
fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
root_cause: The test_aliked.py setup_class clones an external GitHub repo (mvafin/ALIKED) at runtime via `os.system('git clone ...')` without checking the clone's exit status, then immediately runs `git checkout <sha>` in the (possibly empty/failed) target directory. On this runner, the outbound HTTPS connection to github.com failed TLS server-certificate verification (CAfile/CRLfile both 'none'), so the clone silently failed; the subsequent checkout then errored with exit 128 ('not a git repository'). This points to a transient CA-trust-store/network issue reaching github.com from the runner (unrelated to the PR's actual SYCL/dockerfile changes, which only touch .github/dockerfiles and a workflow file), not a defect in the PR under test.
reproduction_steps: On a runner with the same CI image, run: `python -m pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_aliked.py -k aliked-n16rot`. The failure is network/CA-trust dependent and may not reproduce outside the affected runner/time window.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'PyTorch Models tests' job; this is very likely a transient CA/network issue on the runner reaching github.com.

Harden test_aliked.py's setup_class to check the return code of `os.system('git clone ...')` and raise a clear error instead of silently proceeding to `git checkout`, to avoid masking the real failure as a confusing exit-128 'not a git repository' error.

If this recurs frequently, consider mirroring small third-party model repos used by model-hub tests (e.g., ALIKED) into an internal cache/proxy to remove the runtime dependency on live github.com TLS reachability.
prevention_strategies: Avoid relying on `os.system()` (no error checking) for critical clone steps in test setup; use `subprocess.run(..., check=True)` so failures surface immediately with the real git error instead of a confusing follow-on 'not a git repository' error from the next step.
historical_context: Two related but distinct SSL/TLS patterns exist in the database (self-signed-certificate clone failures for Windows submodules and for Smart CI), but neither matches this exact 'server certificate verification failed: CAfile: none CRLfile: none' signature against github.com from the PyTorch model-hub test suite; this is recorded as a new, first-seen pattern.
